n59db9b30f9.headline: Butter for 50 crowns is a normal price. People should get used to it, says the Agricultural Union | Aktuálně.cz
n59db9b30f9.summary: The Agricultural Union of the Czech Republic stated that high consumer prices for butter are influenced by retailers' margins.
n59db9b30f9.why: Retail pricing and supply chain margins impact consumer inflation and agricultural sector profitability.
